about: Lims group is one of the fastest growing business houses in all of UAE. Started in the year 2014, we have ventured into a number of different business functions which includes food and beverage, domestic services, construction and maintenance, corporate solutions etc and we have established a strong foothold in each and every one of them.

Our aim is to build ever lasting relationships with our customers so we do not make any compromises when it comes to the quality of our products and deliver what we promise. Our continuous success can be attributes to the symbiotic relationship we have with our valuable employees. Our motto is together we grow and prosper.
